headline: Data & Software Engineer | .NET • Angular • Data • AI
summary: Versatile Data & Software Engineer with approximately 10 years of experience in .NET Core, Angular, MS SQL Server, SSIS, and Power BI. Experienced in delivering RESTful APIs, ETL pipelines, real-time messaging, and enterprise BI solutions across FinTech, Healthcare, and ERP domains. Also developing expertise in AI-agent architecture, LLM integration, tool/function calling, RAG, and agent workflows using the .NET ecosystem.
targetRoles: AI Application Developer / AI Agent Developer

experience.title: Senior Consultant / Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise software modules for Supply Chain Management and Operating Theatre (OT) operations, improving inventory tracking, procurement workflows, and clinical data management.
Build custom automation and data-processing solutions using Angular, .NET Core, and .NET Framework.
Develop high-performance, multi-threaded console applications to process large datasets efficiently, using asynchronous programming and performance-focused design.
Design, deploy, and maintain SSIS ETL pipelines feeding Power BI dashboards and executive reports; automate dataset refreshes with SQL Server Agent and SSIS packages.
Implement incremental data-loading strategies to reduce processing time and server overhead.

Architect real-time communication features using SignalR hubs and integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications, transactional alerts, and booking updates across Android, iOS, and web platforms.
Design and deploy interactive, paginated SSRS reports backed by complex SQL Server stored procedures and views for business intelligence and analytics.
Improve API and database performance through asynchronous programming, query tuning, strategic caching, and Entity Framework Core schema migrations.
Apply Clean Architecture and layered design patterns to improve maintainability, reusability, and testability.
Lead technical design and architectural planning for KKT International healthcare ERP solutions.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Engineered digital banking solutions for Retail, Corporate, and Internet Banking using .NET MVC, Node.js, and Angular.
Developed secure, high-concurrency RESTful APIs powering core financial workflows.
Built responsive, accessible user interfaces using Angular Material and Bootstrap.

experience.title: Team Lead
highlights: Led cross-functional mobile development delivering cross-platform iOS and Android applications using Ionic Framework.
Architected AngularJS single-page applications, developing custom directives, services, and modular UI components to improve user experience and efficiency.

experience.title: ERP Developer
highlights: Authored complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and views to automate core business workflows.
Performed database performance tuning through execution-plan analysis, index optimization, and query restructuring across large relational databases.
